metadata.author: Mathew Smith
metadata.description: Configurable Datapath video wall operator control for WinCC Unified.

ReloadJson.description: Reload the wall, input, state and result JSON files.

OpenConfigurationStudio.description: Open the Datapath Configuration Studio when EditPermit is true.

CommandWritten.description: Fired after the control writes a pending-command JSON payload.

ConfigurationSaved.description: Fired after the control saves a configuration JSON file.

FileError.description: Fired when a JSON file cannot be read, parsed or written.

JsonFolderPath.description: Folder path for Datapath JSON documents.

WallConfigJson.description: Optional wall-config.json content supplied by a Siemens HMI script bridge.

DatapathInputsJson.description: Optional datapath-inputs.json content supplied by a Siemens HMI script bridge.

DatapathStateJson.description: Optional datapath-state.json content supplied by a Siemens HMI script bridge.

CommandResultJson.description: Optional command-result.json content supplied by a Siemens HMI script bridge.

EditPermit.description: Show the Datapath Configuration Studio pencil button.

RefreshIntervalMs.description: Polling interval for Datapath JSON state files.

PendingCommandJson.description: Last command payload written by the operator.

CommandSequence.description: Incremented every time a command is written.

PendingWallConfigJson.description: Latest wall-config JSON save request from Configuration Studio.

WallConfigSequence.description: Incremented every time wall-config JSON is saved in Configuration Studio.

PendingInputsJson.description: Latest datapath-inputs JSON save request from Configuration Studio.

InputsSequence.description: Incremented every time datapath-inputs JSON is saved in Configuration Studio.

StatusText.description: Latest control, file or Datapath status text.

FileAccessStatus.description: Latest JSON file access operation and result.

LastJsonFilePath.description: Last JSON file path used by the control.

BackgroundColor.description: Control background colour in WinCC Unified ARGB format.

AccentColor.description: Selection accent colour in WinCC Unified ARGB format.
